The general welfare should be advanced","explanation":"The child closely follows C18's post-armistice progression from ending hostilities to cooperative pursuit of tranquility, security, and general welfare."},{"child_excerpt":"the United States, as a friend of all of the countries of the area and as a loyal member of the United Nations, will seek that such hopes prove not to be vain","parent_excerpt":"Also as a member of the United Nations we shall seek to assure that the United Nations continues steadfast in its determination in this respect.","explanation":"Both close the substantive appeal with reassurance that the United States, acting through its UN membership, will continue pursuing the promised political outcome."}]}
